description: Validates the checksum of a 9- or 14-digit Polish business registry number (REGON). 9-digit: weights 8 9 2 3 4 5 6 7 over the first 8 digits, sum mod 11 (10 mapped to 0) must equal the 9th digit. 14-digit: the first 9 digits must themselves be a valid 9-digit REGON, and weights 2 4 8 5 0 9 7 3 6 1 2 4 8 over the first 13 digits (sum mod 11, 10 mapped to 0) must equal the 14th digit.

value.description: digits-only identifier to validate (no spaces or dashes)

name: regon_validate
